name: schematron-rust
summary: Pure Rust ISO/IEC 19757-3 Schematron: rule-based XML validation, with no libxml2, no XSLT processor, no C toolchain, no FFI, and no unsafe.
description: Schematron describes the conditions a document must satisfy — co-occurrence rules, cross-references between distant parts of a document, value relationships, cardinality that depends on content rather than position — written as XPath expressions, layered on top of a grammar (DTD, XML Schema, RELAX NG) rather than used instead of one. This crate contains its own XML parser, its own XPath engine (a complete XPath 1.0 implementation plus a documented XPath 2.0 subset), and its own validator; it interprets a schema directly rather than transpiling it to XSLT. This repository is a monorepo holding the `schematron` crate and its companion website. `schematron/spec/` is normative for the crate's behavior; `spec/` at the repository root is normative for the repository instead — governance, funding, publishing policy — not XPath semantics.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only
